# Marni Blythe Speaks

> Marni Blythe is a professional speaker and the creator of Human Intelligence
> (HI), a framework for the distinctly human skills (presence and
> discernment) that determine how well people lead, communicate, make
> decisions, and work together as technology accelerates. She speaks to
> healthcare and corporate leaders, and to education and real estate
> organizations, at conferences, annual meetings, retreats, study clubs, and
> all-staff events. She has served as a fractional executive inside surgical
> practices and growing organizations.

## Four Signature Programs
- [Human Intelligence in an AI World](https://marniblythespeaks.com/speaking#human-intelligence): Marni's flagship program (keynote, a half- or full-day workshop; in-person, virtual, or hybrid). Introduces her Human Intelligence Framework, an Internal Operating System for leading yourself before leading others: presence, awareness, emotional regulation, beliefs, vulnerability, and discernment.
- [The Formula for Predictable Growth](https://marniblythespeaks.com/speaking#predictable-growth): clarity, alignment, accountability, scorecards, and focus for owners and leadership teams.
- [Culture By Design, Not Default](https://marniblythespeaks.com/speaking#culture-by-design): how leaders intentionally build culture, trust, and psychological safety.
- [Navigating High-Stakes Conversations](https://marniblythespeaks.com/speaking#high-stakes-conversations): the CORE Conversation Framework for feedback, accountability, and conflict.
